title: Dashboard source hygiene — the equity line was subtracting across a currency boundary, three days late

fault_1.what: the subtraction crossed a currency boundary
fault_1.detail: meta.paper_start carries its own note saying CAD; meta.broker_equity carries no currency at all; the difference was rendered with a dollar sign on a page where every other money figure is USD, for an account that now holds USD

fault_2.what: the payload was three days old and the page could not tell
fault_2.detail: the envelope reported freshness=not_expected_yet, not stale, because in track1-only mode the legacy runner is never scheduled so expected_next_at keeps sliding forward
fault_2.consequence: the page's own staleness guard — ['missing','unknown','stale'].includes(freshness) — never fired
fault_2.principle: a freshness model that assumes its producer still runs cannot report a producer that has stopped

authoritative_source_now.track1_paper_account: track1-runtime.paper_account — the recorded baseline, proven against the broker
authoritative_source_now.current_broker: /api/v1/broker.payload.equity, only when fresh, labelled 'broker now', never merged into the baseline figure
authoritative_source_now.legacy_runner_figure: shown only under the name 'Legacy runner state', always with its age, never as the current account
authoritative_source_now.divergence_behaviour: the line names the legacy figure and its age and turns negative
authoritative_source_now.account_line_no_longer_consults: runner.freshness — it uses the age, which is a fact, rather than a schedule which in this mode is a fiction

open_issues_treatment.why: a log parser holding a second opinion about what stops orders is how two answers come to disagree
open_issues_treatment.derived_from: the issue key, not a hand-kept list of titles
open_issues_treatment.visual: one chip in the existing badge lane, same pill geometry as the status beside it; legacy and debt lanes deliberately quieter than TRACK 1; no new section, no new card

restart.mechanism: open_issue_reader is imported at module top (app.py:39) and bound at boot; track1_runtime_reader is imported inside the handler (app.py:249) and was picked up only because nothing had called that endpoint between the restart and the edit
restart.corrects_previous_stage: Stage 5ZZE said no backend restart was required, having measured the new block being served. The measurement was right and the conclusion too general — it was served by luck of import ordering, not by a reload mechanism
restart.js_and_css: static files; a browser refresh is enough for the equity line and the chip styling
restart.nothing_worse_meanwhile: the issues are all still listed; they simply carry no scope chip yet

reader_mutations: a legacy issue promoted to Track 1
scoping quietly filtering instead of labelling
the log parser declaring its own readiness blockers
page_mutations: the account line reverting to the legacy number (3 of 5 browser tests fail)
the divergence threshold removed so nothing is ever material (1 fails)

pre_existing_test_rewritten_not_deleted.why: it asserted the delta 4,168 appeared — it pinned the very behaviour this stage removed, including the cross-currency subtraction
pre_existing_test_rewritten_not_deleted.kept: its concern — a sharp divergence around the account must be visible rather than averaged away
pre_existing_test_rewritten_not_deleted.now: measures that divergence between the recorded baseline and the legacy figure, on the same scenario, and asserts the old delta is gone in every spelling

faults_in_my_own_tests.what: a substring assertion read my own comment
faults_in_my_own_tests.detail: assert "Broker acct" not in JS found the phrase inside the comment recording what was wrong
faults_in_my_own_tests.note: that trap has now caught this project four times
faults_in_my_own_tests.fix: the reader strips comments, and a second assertion demands the explanatory comment is still there

faults_in_my_own_tests.detail: JS[i:i+3000] ran past the account line into runnerFreshnessText, so an assertion about one function read another's source
faults_in_my_own_tests.fix: bounded at its own closing statement

faults_in_my_own_tests.what: a cached reader made a mutation into a no-op
faults_in_my_own_tests.detail: read_open_issues memoises on a file/date signature, so patching the builder changed nothing and the mutation test passed while proving nothing
faults_in_my_own_tests.fix: the cache is cleared before and after, and the test asserts the issue list is non-empty first

fault_in_production_code.what: _build called _scoped(issues) for its side effect and then read issues again
fault_in_production_code.why_it_matters: it works while _scoped labels in place and breaks silently the day it returns a new list
fault_in_production_code.how_found: the mutation turned a wrong answer into a KeyError
fault_in_production_code.fix: the caller uses the return value
